glance.headline: Property tax demand notice for Rs. 3,840.00 due by 31 Dec 2026.

summary: Anand Nagar Municipality has issued a property tax demand notice for the second half of 2026-27.
The total amount due is Rs. 3,840.00, which must be paid by 31 December 2026 to avoid penalties.
An early payment rebate is available if paid on or before 30 November 2026, reducing the amount to Rs. 3,648.00.
Payments can be made online or in person at the Municipal office counter.
spoken_summary: This is a property tax notice from Anand Nagar Municipality for Kamala Devi. The total demand for the second half of 2026-27 is Rs. 3,840.00. You can pay Rs. 3,648.00 before 30 November 2026 to get a rebate. The last date to pay without penalty is 31 December 2026. You can pay online or visit the municipal office counter.
